title: Forge: DigitalOcean Premium Droplets Are Now Available
content: <html><head></head><body>A few weeks ago, DigitalOcean introduced new Premium Droplets with faster Intel and AMD CPUs, enhanced memory performance, and high-performance disks. And starting today, you may use these Droplets on Forge when specifying the "Server Size" while creating a new server.</body></html>
author: Nuno Maduro
